'''Oriolanis''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="NEGWT" /> located in the [[Oriolanis system/Legends|Oriolanis system]], a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Oriolan sector/Legends|Oriolan sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The minor technology company [[Oriolanis Defense Systems/Legends|Oriolanis Defense Systems]],<ref name="NEGWT" /> which existed by [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Jedi Quest: The Shadow Trap]]'', the events of which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], mentions [[Striker projectile pistol]]s being used [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier. According to ''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'', those [[Pistol/Legends|pistols]] were manufactured by [[Oriolanis Defense Systems/Legends|Oriolanis Defense Systems]], meaning that the company must have existed by [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> was based on Oriolanis.<ref name="NEGWT" /> Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Oriolanis was the site of a Class II military [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The output of the facility was limited to [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oriolanis was first mentioned in the [[2004]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'', authored by [[W. Haden Blackman]].<ref name="NEGWT" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Oriolanis [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square J-16.<ref name="TEA" />
